name: The Black Phalanx

desc: A set of matched poniards bearing the inscription Grim

desc: A pike used by Turanian warlords
intro: The Turanian army is feared throughout the west for their ever-expanding grasp and long-standing plans of conquest. There is a sense of impending doom over every kingdom that stands like a bulwark, border to border, with Turan.

title: The Mallet

intro: This carpenter's hammer was never designed to work as an actual tool. Rather, it is an implement meant to sap someone's strength when clobbering them.

intro: When the world was young, there was a great sage known as Epemitreus. Little is known of the shadowy past in which he fought with Set, the arch-demon, but it is known that for all the days of his life he strove against the worshippers, votaries and acolytes of the Old Serpent.

title: The Tenderizer

desc: A powerful mace blessed by Yog
intro: The rough appearance of this mace belies the terrible power concealed within. Decorated with the swirling symbols that make up a single syllable of the unutterable name of Yog, this mace is heavy with the darkness of Yog.

title: The Wightblade

desc: A set of ceremonial daggers used by the Zathite priests
intro: These daggers, crafted in worship of the god Zath, are symbolic representations of the purifying venom of Zath. They tear and rend flesh with the same enthusiasm as the spider god himself.

title: Zathite Spear
name: Zathite Spear
desc: A longspear affixed with a fang of Zath

title: Zhaibar Knives
name: Zhaibar Knives
desc: A pair of knives forged in Zhaibar
intro: It is not known whether it is some special quality to the metal forged in Zhaibar, or if it is simply the training that they give their warriors, but all know that the wielder of a Zhaibar blade is to be feared.
